changes.comment: ai-assist: IAiClientTool.execute is now a method signature with an optional second parameter, IAiClientToolExecuteContext { signal? }, and executeClientToolTurn passes the turn's AbortSignal to it so a cancelled turn can stop the tool; existing one-parameter tools are unaffected. Note: the method form makes execute's parameters bivariant, so a tool can declare execute(args: { a; b }) against IAiClientToolConfig<{ a }> without a compile error; runtime stays safe because executeClientToolTurn validates args against the config's parametersSchema before calling execute
